text: {"angles":[{"angle":"When Bitcoin drops sharply, fear and manipulation can cloud judgment, but the same fear often marks a bull-market wall of worry rather than a reason to sell.","moments":["4d14201f553f57dc7672","44a6d503ed11992f6f8e","d6adeb54ad64062081c5","93cfa865d13a0c3e1709"],"hook":"4d14201f553f57dc7672","support":{"4d14201f553f57dc7672":"Opens with the scary weekend drop and the sell question, setting up the emotional decision.","44a6d503ed11992f6f8e":"Adds that people manipulate emotions to make holders part with Bitcoin, explaining the sell pressure after the drop.","d6adeb54ad64062081c5":"Shows fear can rise while Bitcoin trends up in a bull market, reframing the drop as a wall of worry.","93cfa865d13a0c3e1709":"Ends with the scale of the weekend liquidation, reinforcing why fear feels overwhelming but is part of the same setup."}},{"angle":"Big liquidations and pullbacks are scary, but fear and manipulation can cloud judgment, and fear often rises alongside Bitcoin in a bull market.","moments":["185e37a64058e69111ae","44a6d503ed11992f6f8e","d6adeb54ad64062081c5","93cfa865d13a0c3e1709"],"hook":"185e37a64058e69111ae","support":{"185e37a64058e69111ae":"Opens with the large liquidation and 25% pullback, establishing the scary market event.","44a6d503ed11992f6f8e":"Adds that manipulation targets emotions to make people part with Bitcoin, explaining the impulse to sell after liquidations.","d6adeb54ad64062081c5":"Shows massive fear during a bull market while Bitcoin trended up, offering historical context for the fear.","93cfa865d13a0c3e1709":"Ends with the weekend's leverage wipeout, giving concrete scale to the liquidation fear."}}]}
